400.description: Invalid argument - The client specified an invalid argument

401.description: Unauthenticated - The request does not have valid authentication credentials

403.description: Permission denied - The caller does not have permission to execute the specified operation

404.description: Not found - Some requested entity was not found

408.description: Deadline exceeded - The deadline expired before the operation could complete

409.description: Aborted - The operation was aborted due to concurrency issue

412.description: Failed precondition - Operation was rejected because the system is not in required state

413.description: Out of range - Operation was attempted past the valid range

429.description: Resource exhausted - Some resource has been exhausted (rate limiting)

431.description: Request header fields too large - Request metadata was too large

499.description: Cancelled - The operation was cancelled by the client

501.description: Unimplemented - The operation is not implemented or supported

503.description: Unavailable - The service is currently unavailable

504.description: Deadline exceeded - Upstream service did not respond in time

BetaManagedAgentsUpdateAgentParams.description: Request parameters for updating an `agent`. Omit a field to preserve its current value.

example.system: You are a general-purpose agent that can research, write code, run commands, and use connected tools to complete the user's task end to end.

description.description: Description. Omit to preserve; send empty string or null to clear.

mcp_servers.description: MCP servers. Full replacement. Omit to preserve; send empty array or `null` to clear. Names must be unique. Maximum 20. Every server must be referenced by an `mcp_toolset` in the agent's resulting `tools`; unreferenced servers are rejected. See the [MCP connector guide](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/mcp-connector).

metadata.description: Metadata patch. Set a key to a string to upsert it, or to null to delete it. Omit the field to preserve. The stored bag is limited to 16 keys (up to 64 chars each) with values up to 512 chars.

model.description: Model identifier. Accepts the [model string](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview#latest-models-comparison), e.g. `claude-opus-5`, or a `model_config` object for additional configuration control. Omit to preserve. Cannot be cleared.

multiagent.description: Multiagent orchestration configuration. Full replacement. Omit to preserve; send null to clear.

name.description: Human-readable name. Must be non-empty. Omit to preserve. Cannot be cleared.

skills.description: Skills. Full replacement. Omit to preserve; send empty array or null to clear.

system.description: System prompt. Omit to preserve; send empty string or null to clear.
examples: You are a general-purpose agent that can research, write code, run commands, and use connected tools to complete the user's task end to end.

tools.description: Tool configurations available to the agent. Full replacement. Omit to preserve; send empty array or null to clear. Maximum of 128 tools across all toolsets allowed.

version.description: The agent's current version, used to prevent concurrent overwrites. Obtain this value from a create or retrieve response. Must be at least 1 if specified. When supplied, the request fails if it does not match the server's current version; omit to apply the update unconditionally.

example.name: My First Agent
example.system: You are a general-purpose agent that can research, write code, run commands, and use connected tools to complete the user's task end to end.

archived_at.description: When the agent was archived. Null if not archived.

multiagent.description: Multiagent orchestration configuration. Null when the agent is single-threaded.

examples: You are a general-purpose agent that can research, write code, run commands, and use connected tools to complete the user's task end to end.

version.description: The agent's current version. Starts at 1 and increments when the agent is modified.

BetaManagedAgentsModelConfigParams.description: An object that defines additional configuration control over model use

effort.description: How hard Claude works on each inference call. Accepts a bare level string (`"high"`) or `{"type": "high"}`. On create, omitting it resolves the per-model default; on update, omitting it leaves the stored value unchanged.

inference_geo.description: Geographic region for model inference. When unset, requests fall through to the workspace's default_inference_geo. On update, `model` is whole-object replacement — omitting inference_geo clears it.

BetaManagedAgentsMultiagentCoordinatorPa.description: A coordinator topology: the session's primary thread orchestrates work by spawning session threads, each running an agent drawn from the `agents` roster.

agents.description: Agents the coordinator may spawn as session threads. 1–20 entries. Each entry is an agent ID string, a versioned `{"type":"agent","id","version"}` reference, or `{"type":"self"}` to allow recursive self-invocation. Entries must reference distinct agents (after resolving `self` and string forms); at most one `self`. Referenced agents must exist, must not be archived, and must not themselves have `multiagent` set (depth limit 1).

version.description: Version to pin. Defaults to latest if omitted.

skill_id.description: Tagged ID of the custom skill (e.g., "skill_01XJ5...").
